author: Towermagi
title: Scammy company
content:
This whole system/company feels like a SCAM for anyone NOT a citizen or permanent resident of Mainland China.  They offer travelers a Travel Pass for people who are visiting China but then after depositing money into Travel Pass they lock your account and claim they need to verify your identity and can only do so with a Mainland China bank card.  Well, guess what?  You can’t get a Mainland Chinese bank card without being a citizen or permanent resident.  So much for Travel Pass working for travelers who aren’t either.  

Customer service is an absolute joke.  I have tried the US support number (it’s always voicemail, I left several A MONTH ago, not holding my breath on a response), the Chinese support number is “no longer in service”, I have sent several emails and I have even tried Facebook.  I have never encountered a company of this supposed size that is so unprofessional bordering on fraudulent.

In fact this whole system appears to be one giant scam because they claim Travel Pass is for foreigners to China but then require citizen status (only after they have taken your money).

Here is what happened to me:  They let me register for the app with my US debit card.  Everything went through perfectly fine, the app even said I can use my US debit card to verify my identity.  I then put 500RMB into my Travel Pass account.  Then the next day, when I tried to launch the app, they claimed they needed to reverify my identity.  I put in my US debit card again and got the message that they cannot accept that card as verification.  So my card was good enough to let me register and then deduct money from, but once they’ve taken the money, my card is no longer good for verification?  Sounds like a SCAM to me.  Check Facebook, I’m not the only one that fell for this scam, there are a ton of people on there with their money taken and then unable to reverify.

I will be filing a complaint for this company with the Apple app store because they should not be allowed to be on here.
